# remote_git_tool

> Perform git operations on a remote code workspace via SSH.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `developer` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=remote_git_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Perform git operations on a remote code workspace via SSH.

Operations:
- status: Show working tree status (porcelain format)
- diff: Show diffs (optionally staged, optionally for a specific file)
- log: Show commit history
- add: Stage files
- commit: Create a commit with a message
- push: Push to remote
- pull: Pull from remote
- branch: List, create, or checkout branches
- current_branch: Get the current branch name

EXAMPLES:

Check status:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", operation: "status"}

View staged diff:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", operation: "diff", staged: true}

Commit changes:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", operation: "commit", message: "Fix user validation bug"}

Create and checkout new branch:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", operation: "branch", create: "feature/new-api"}

List branches:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", operation: "branch", list: true}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_slug` | string | yes | Workspace slug identifying which remote server to connect to. |
| `operation` | string | yes | Git operation to perform. One of: `status`, `diff`, `log`, `add`, `commit`, `push`, `pull`, `branch`, `current_branch`. |
| `file` | string | no | File path for diff operation. |
| `staged` | boolean | no | Show staged changes (for diff operation) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Number of commits to show (for log, default: 20) |
| `oneline` | boolean | no | Use oneline format for log. |
| `files` | string | no | Files to stage (for add operation, default: ".") |
| `message` | string | no | Commit message (required for commit operation) |
| `remote` | string | no | Remote name (default: "origin") |
| `branch` | string | no | Branch name (for push/pull/branch checkout) |
| `create` | string | no | Create and checkout new branch with this name. |
| `checkout` | string | no | Checkout existing branch. |
| `list` | boolean | no | List all branches. |
| `from_branch` | string | no | Base branch to create the new branch from (defaults to workspace default_branch). Only used with create. |
